verdict.rationale: Drata explicitly documents automating compliance workflows with custom triggers/actions, continuous monitoring tests, and evidence collection via integrations (drata-docs-1, drata-docs-3, drata-docs-14), and the Drata Agent runs persistent background checks on endpoints (drata-gh-1, drata-gh-2), which together constitute autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that triggers execute reliably without human intervention, and technical detail on scheduling/failure handling beyond marketing copy.
